purpose: Original background instrumental for owner-created Meta Pet photo slideshows
composition: Original procedural instrumental composed for this project, using locally synthesized pad, pluck and bass tones. No stock audio, downloaded recording, voice or sampled song was used.
derivation: First 48 seconds of the original 180-second composition, preserving its intro fade and adding a 2.5-second outro fade; encoded as MP3 at 96 kbps.
playback: Preview starts only after the owner presses Play. Video export uses this same bundled audio asset.
